summary: Art portfolio/gallery web app with admin panel. Admin can manage paintings (edit, delete, mark as sold with visual indicator). Live at Version 4.

existing_features.title: In the AdminPaintingList component, ensure each painting row displays clearly functional Edit, Delete, and Mark as Sold/Available action buttons. The Edit action should open the AdminPaintingForm pre-populated with the existing painting data. The Delete action should show a confirmation dialog before permanently removing the painting. The Mark as Sold toggle should immediately update the painting's sold status.

Display a prominent visual SOLD indicator on sold paintings in both the public gallery and the painting detail page. This should include a bold diagonal 'SOLD' stamp overlay on the painting's primary image and a SOLD badge near the title or price with a strikethrough on the price. The AdminPaintingList table should also show a clear sold/available status label per row.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin ability to edit any current painting listing, delete a painting post, or label it as sold — with visual graphics (e.g., SOLD badge/overlay) shown to public users.

Add backend support for updating an existing painting's fields (title, description, price, images, sold status) via an admin-only update function. Ensure delete and sold-status toggle operations are also available as admin-only backend calls.
